test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is 'longing.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence "***Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace, and the ___(3)___ to be a great artist never wholly left him***'' is indicating something about the artist in Pasteur. • The use of the phrase ''**never** left'' in the sentence indicates **never went away from**. • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'longing'. • The word 'longing' means **a yearning desire**. • Example:* She was **longing** for some peace and privacy*. Hence, the correct answer is option 3. Complete Sentence: *Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace, and the **longing** to be a great artist never wholly left him**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • Let us explore the other options: • 'Itching' means **feeling a restless or strong desire to do something**. (बेचैन या कुछ करने की तीव्र इच्छा महसूस करना) • 'Wishing' means **wanting to do something**. (कुछ करने की चाह रखना, कुछ चाहना) • 'Loathing' means **feeling intense dislike or disgust for someone or something**. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से नफ़रत करना) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य "*Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace, and the ___(3)___ to be a great artist never wholly left him*'' पाश्चर के अंदर के कलाकार के बारे में कुछ बता रहा है। • वाक्य में phrase ''never left'' का प्रयोग यह इंगित करता है कि कभी दूर नहीं गया। • इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'longing' है। • 'Longing' शब्द का अर्थ है **लालसा, चाहत**। • उदाहरण: *She was longing for some peace and privacy*. अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है। पूर्ण वाक्य: *Perhaps the memories of his boyhood days, when he drew the familiar scenes of his birthplace, and the longing to be a great artist never wholly left him**.* 4a:T1e54, The correct answer is 'become.'
